verdict.rationale: The Cactus Engine documents OpenAI-compatible APIs for text, speech and vision (gh-2), and HuggingFace models can be converted (gh-1, experimental) and started with `cactus run` (gh-6). Nothing shows these APIs exposed as a local HTTP server, though; they may be in-process bindings only. Missing for 10: a documented command to launch a local OpenAI-compatible HTTP server, endpoint/port details, confirmation that any loaded model can be served, and independent hands-on corroboration.
